items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Well, Louis Cotterall was actually a guy who was a musician.

ctx.x: So the band was Bush. Bush. And then my cousin Laura, Paul. Outside of that, I don't know. How about Louis Cotterall? Well, Louis Cotterall was actually a guy who was a musician.
He was known as a pretty good musician back then. Yeah, musician, yeah. He told me he played with Chris Kelly, son.
